question_text: If a gland loses its duct but continues secretions, how will its classification change?
explanation: If a gland loses its duct but continues secretions, its classification changes from an exocrine gland (which has ducts) to an endocrine gland (which is ductless). Exocrine glands release their products through a duct to a surface. Endocrine glands (ductless glands) release their secretions (hormones) directly into the bloodstream after losing their connection to the epithelial surface. Hence, the correct answer is "It becomes endocrine".
